claims.note: The rule the take showed had two halves — a name is held by a conversation that is in this room AND running — and the second half was dropped deliberately in the same commit that made a room keep its members across a relaunch. The take's own observation is unchanged: the earlier Gemini had *left the room*, which still frees the name, and the first test below is the one that pins it.
